displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in agent pickers

description.description: What this agent type is for

category.description: Group this agent type appears under in pickers

defaultCommand.description: The default command to run when the message to the agent does not start with a '/'

debug.description: Log extra diagnostic output for this agent type

initialCommands.description: Commands run automatically when an agent of this type starts

createMessage.description: Message logged when an agent of this type is created

headless.description: Run without an interactive chat surface

minimumRunning.description: Keep at least this many agents of this type running

idleTimeout.description: Shut idle agents down after this long (0 disables)

maxRunTime.description: Hard limit on agent runtime (0 disables)

name.description: The exact name of the tool that was called

args.description: The arguments passed to the tool

message.description: A single line markdown string, with a bolded intent at the beginning, that summarizes what was done i.e. "**File** Read 3 files"

actions.description: An itemized list of actions taken, which is displayed as a list under the item in verbose mode.Should not included the bolded intent, i.e. ["Read a.txt", "Read b.txt", "Read c.txt"]

failed.description: Whether the tool call soft-failed, i.e. was not called properly or returned not-useful results

result.description: The result of the tool call, sent to the LLM
